KBS:kbs_anomaly_detection.note: Outliers within the same provider series. Cross-provider anomaly detection is a different capability and is not this one.

KBS:kbs_bollinger_bands.note: Dispersion around a mean of the same series.

KBS:kbs_cross_provider_corroboration.note: Comparing KBS against another provider to detect divergence. Agreement is compatibility evidence and never raises either provider's authority.

KBS:kbs_days_to_liquidate.note: Divides a position by daily volume. If that volume includes negotiated blocks that were never available to a screen order, the answer is wrong in the optimistic direction, which is the direction that loses money.

KBS:kbs_descriptive_price_statistics.note: Range, mean, dispersion over the KBS series. Descriptive of the series.

KBS:kbs_descriptive_trading_value_statis.note: va is present on only part of the retained history. In the tested windows its absence is perfectly associated with the empirically adjusted / off-lattice row group; the mechanism is unknown and the association is not generalised beyond those windows. Coverage is enforced by kbs_trading_value_coverage, not by this note: an aggregate claiming a whole window must prove the window is covered.

KBS:kbs_descriptive_volume_statistics.note: Same series on both sides, so an unknown constant composition cancels.

KBS:kbs_executable_capacity_claim.note: Capacity is days-to-liquidate integrated over a book.

KBS:kbs_historical_chart.note: A chart of one provider's series, labelled as that provider's series.

KBS:kbs_liquidity_adjusted_sizing.note: Sizing against a figure whose executable fraction is unknown.

KBS:kbs_liquidity_dependent_ranking.note: Ranking or recommending on volume presented as qualified market liquidity.

KBS:kbs_market_impact_estimation.note: Impact models are calibrated against matched continuous volume.

KBS:kbs_moving_average.note: A mean over the KBS series.

KBS:kbs_negotiated_flow_analysis.note: Requires a split no observed KBS surface carries.

KBS:kbs_official_exchange_price_claim.note: An observed web endpoint with no published schema is not the exchange.

KBS:kbs_official_total_return_claim.note: Total return requires a known distribution treatment. The method is undocumented.

KBS:kbs_ohlcv_display.note: Showing the retained daily series as the provider reported it. This was never a claim about adjustment or composition, and blocking it bought nothing.

KBS:kbs_participation_rate_sizing.note: A participation rate is a fraction of executable matched volume.

KBS:kbs_point_in_time_valuation.note: The value the series reports for a past date is not the value that was quoted on that date, so it cannot support a claim about what was knowable then.

KBS:kbs_production_backtest.note: A production backtest reports a capacity it cannot support, over a price series that is restated after the fact.

KBS:kbs_provider_price_momentum.note: Direction of the KBS series over time, not a claim about realisable return.

KBS:kbs_provider_relative_volume.note: Today's KBS volume against its own trailing mean: a ratio within one series.

KBS:kbs_provider_series_return.note: The series is event-adjusted by an undocumented method, so a return computed over it is neither an as-traded return nor a total shareholder return. It is the return of this provider's series, and it must say so.

KBS:kbs_provider_series_technical_contin.note: An already-adjusted series is continuous across an ex-date, which is what makes it usable for indicator continuity. Reapplying a corporate-action factor to it would adjust it twice.

KBS:kbs_shadow_analytics.note: Analytics that claim no official, raw or executable-market semantics.

KBS:kbs_shadow_backtest.note: Eligibility only. This milestone implements no backtest, and the eligibility conditions in SHADOW_BACKTEST_CONDITIONS are all required together.

KBS:kbs_technical_pattern_research.note: Research scope. It may not be presented as a liquidity or executability finding.

KBS:kbs_volume_derived_actionability_upg.note: No KBS finding may raise is_actionable. The unit being shares is true and is not an actionability input.

limitations: Three qualified events across three tickers, all in 2026. Older history, rights issues and par-value changes are untested.
No first-party methodology exists, so which events the provider adjusts for -- and which it silently does not -- is unknown.
